review.notes: Line-level diff of the OCR Markdown against extracted text from all 17 physical PDF pages; physical pages 6, 16 and 17 were rendered (170 dpi) and visually verified, plus the Figure 9 embedded image was inspected directly. No dropped footnote bodies (the report has no footnotes), no code fences, and no garbled numbers were found; the reference list matches the print entry-by-entry. Two OCR-promoted run-in labels were demoted and one printed appendix heading was restored. Several oddities are printed by the PDF itself and were deliberately left unchanged (see unresolved).

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.6 section 3.1 shows 'Cross-embodiment data' as a bold run-in label inside one paragraph ('...Collecting large-scale teleoperation data on our high-DoF Byte-Dexter platform is constrained by...'), styled exactly like the sibling run-ins 'Vision-language data' and 'Human trajectories' (visually verified at 170 dpi). OCR promoted the label to a Markdown heading and split the sentence.

Rendered physical p.16 Contributions and Acknowledgements shows 'Supervisor Hang Li' as a bold run-in label in the same list as 'Hardware', 'Control and System' and 'Model and Data', not a section heading (visually verified at 170 dpi).
Rendered physical p.17 prints 'Grasping Capability' as a blue subsection heading under 'Appendix' (visually verified at 170 dpi); OCR demoted it to plain body text before the Figure 9 embed.

unresolved.evidence: The sentence 'Building upon the ByteDexter V1 design, this work presents an upgraded version that increases the total' ends physical p.9 and continues 'DoFs by one while achieving...' on p.10; OCR interleave order places section 4/5 figures between the halves. Rejoining would require moving figure embeds.

Printed by the PDF itself and transcribed faithfully, left unpatched per source-review policy: 'multiple robot embodiment' singular (p.6); run-in label 'Our-of-Distribution Settings' misspelling (p.7); caption 'Figure 8 Experiment settings and Results...' capitalization (p.9); reference [4] 'Qwen2. 5-vl technical report' with a printed space (p.12); reference [52] author list printed as 'Ananye Shaw, Kenneth andAgarwal and Deepak Pathak' (p.14).
The vertical arXiv sidebar stamp 'arXiv:2512.24210v2 [cs.RO] 9 Jan 2026' (p.1 margin) is not in the OCR text; stamps are conventionally omitted from readers.
